full_judgment: 14. In the original case, the pre-emptor Ainuddin as witness No.1 (P.W. I) deposed before the trial court. In his testimony he has categorically testified that the case joie originally belonged to their mother and other co-sharers and her mother used to possess in ejmali. In R.S. khatian No.701 the name of his mother has been recorded against plot No.748. Subsequently, a registered bonton-nama was held on 10.04.1985 and by virtue of that bonton-nama the case land devolved upon her mother Sagori Bibi and at the demise of her mother as legal heirs the pre-emptor along with his brother the opposite party No.2 and two sisters inherited the property of their mother. P.W.I in his testimony also testified that his brother the vendor-opposite party No.2 transferred the case land without serving any notice to the co-sharers, in favour of the stranger opposite party No.1 and the purchaser opposite party No.1 while on 24.10.2005 coming to the homestead of him (P.W. I) wanted demarcation of the case land; he (pre-emptor) for the first time came to know about the case transfer. P.W.1 further testified that on 26.10.2005 going to the concerned Puthia Sub-register's office he obtained the certified copy of the case kabala, from where he came to know finally that on 17.05.2005 the Sub-register signed the deed. P.W.1 in his deposition also testified that, he has not more than 7/8 bighas of land in all.
